note: Pinned runtimes for benchmarks/compare-v1.4. drive.py installs each one into its own throwaway uv environment; nothing here is installed into the laya-apple environment except laya-apple itself.
checkpoints_from: laya_apple.registry (the revisions laya-apple pins); every runtime that can load the upstream checkpoint loads exactly these snapshots

variant_notes.auto: default: MLX GPU, validated ANE artifacts for short single questions (execution=inline)

laya-mlx.upstream_basis: NandhaKishorM/laya prompt and output code at 573e5b62 plus the v0.3.5 temperature clamp (README)
laya-mlx.weights: the same upstream checkpoint snapshot as laya-apple (laya_mlx.load accepts a local checkpoint directory)

source.note: the source tree is only used for its published fixtures (benchmarks/results/reference.json); the runtime is the 0.1.0 wheel

laya-coreml.upstream_basis: NandhaKishorM/laya at 573e5b62 plus the v0.3.5 temperature clamp (README)

variant_notes.default: enumerated-shape Core ML export, compute_units cpu_gpu (the package default)
variant_notes.ane: fixed B1/L96 ANE bundle, compute_units cpu_ne; requests over 96 tokens raise a capacity error

laya-coreml.weights: the project's own Core ML bundles, exported from the same upstream revisions (bundle manifests record the source weight hash; checked at run time)

laya-fast.upstream_basis: the Hugging Face convaiinnovations/laya reference code (rl_agent_api.py) at 1c5edc17 (NOTICE)
laya-fast.checkpoint_note: The README pins convaiinnovations/laya@1c5edc17. Every file drive.py uses (model.safetensors, rl_agent_config.json, encoder/, tokenizer/) is identical to the c5d78730 snapshot laya-apple pins; only README.md differs (Hugging Face tree API, checked by drive.py setup). convert.py therefore runs on laya-apple's snapshot.

variant_notes.mlx: LayaMLX(converted-fp16, dtype=float16, compile=True): the CLI default --agent mlx
variant_notes.fast: LayaFast(converted-fp16) with the ANE bodies exported by ane/export.py for every bucket in ane_buckets

laya-fast.weights: convert.py output (MLX fp16) of the same upstream snapshot; English checkpoint only

upstream.role: reference: unmodified upstream Laya, PyTorch CPU FP32 (the golden recipe), for fixtures that have no committed goldens
